verdict.zh_hant: 人體佔據騎行總風阻的 75%~80%。無接縫貼合連體服在風洞實測中省瓦驚人（40km/h 基準下約 11W），每瓦成本僅約 ¥136，性價比直接碾壓昂貴的大深框碳輪！
verdict.en: The rider's body accounts for ~80% of total aerodynamic drag. A snug speedsuit saves ~11W at 40 km/h in wind tunnels at just ~$20/W—far better ROI than expensive wheels.

name.zh_hant: 低風阻分體騎行服 (Aero Jersey)

verdict.zh_hant: 相比傳統寬鬆版型兜風的騎行服，手臂與肩部採用導流條紋面料的修身服省瓦極佳，百元投入換來 33 秒提升，新手必改首選。
verdict.en: Compared to loose-fitting jerseys that parachute in headwinds, tight ribbed aero fabrics save ~7.5W. Exceptional budget upgrade.

name.zh_hant: 全氣動破風頭盔 (Aero Road Helmet)

verdict.zh_hant: 針對頭部正面高風壓區導流優化（如 Evade 3 / Utopia）。雖然夏天炎熱爬坡散熱稍遜，但平路 35km/h 以上巡航節省瓦數非常穩定。
verdict.en: Optimizes high frontal pressure zone over the head. Slightly warmer on summer climbs, but yields dependable 5W gains on high-speed flats.

verdict.zh_hant: 相比原廠鋁輪，50mm 框高是平路破風與抗側風的最佳平衡點。外圈旋轉慣性極佳，時速 32km/h 以上能清晰感受「被風托著走」的巡航感。
verdict.en: The gold-standard rim depth balancing aero drag and crosswind stability. Distinct flywheel cruise momentum above 32 km/h.

verdict.zh_hant: 純平路單飛、鐵三與繞圈衝刺神器。缺點是重量偏重，且突發側風時對車手操控技術與體重要求較高，泛用性不如 50mm。
verdict.en: Outstanding on dead-flat courses and crits. However, prone to crosswind buffeting and slower to spin up on punchy climbs.

name.zh_hant: 一體全內走線碳把 (Integrated Handlebar)

verdict.zh_hant: 隱藏車頭迎風面全部裸露線管，視覺極度純淨，扁平翼型把橫提供良好氣動截面。唯一的缺點是裝車穿管與維護調校成本成倍上升。
verdict.en: Completely hides cables from the frontal airstream with sleek wing-profile tops. Outstanding aesthetics, though increases mechanic maintenance time.

name.zh_hant: 超輕 TPU 內胎 (28g~36g 對裝)

verdict.zh_hant: 百元級別「最強平民物理外掛」！相比普通丁基膠內胎，直接減去輪組最外圈 140g 旋轉質量，滾阻省 ~3.2W，起步加速感極其輕快！
verdict.en: The single best bang-for-buck upgrade. Slashes 140g of rotating rim mass and saves ~3.2W rolling resistance for just ~$25. Instant acceleration boost.

verdict.zh_hant: 滯後損失極低，路感柔和細膩、貼地吸震感超越 TPU。唯一缺點是乳膠微孔分子較大，基本需要每天出車前打氣。
verdict.en: Extremely low hysteresis loss with silky, supple road feel. The only caveat is fast air loss requiring daily pumping.

name.zh_hant: 真空胎無內胎系統 (Tubeless System)

verdict.zh_hant: 徹底消除內胎與外胎之間的剪切摩擦力，配合自補液可自愈微小扎胎，且能以更低胎壓行駛獲得巨大抓地力與舒適度。初次安裝打氣需要氣泵技巧。
verdict.en: Eliminates casing-tube friction completely. Offers puncture self-repair and allows lower pressures for unmatched grip and speed.

name.zh_hant: 高純度熱浸石蠟鏈條 (Hot Melt Waxed Chain)

verdict.zh_hant: 硬核技師強推！石蠟在金屬微孔內形成固態潤滑，完全不吸附泥沙黑油，傳動阻力比普通濕性鏈條油低 3~4W，且鏈條和飛輪壽命延長 3 倍！
verdict.en: Mechanic's favorite! Solid paraffin wax repels road dust and dirt completely, saving ~3.5W friction while tripling chain and cassette life.

name.zh_hant: 陶瓷超大導輪系統 (OSPW 大雞腿)

verdict.zh_hant: 【爭議/性價比極低】加大導輪雖能微減鏈條彎折阻力，但實測僅省 1W 上下，且增加後撥總重、降低換擋清脆度。主要價值在於高調顏值與心理信仰。
verdict.en: Controversial low-ROI upgrade. Laboratory gains are only ~1.2W at very high cost (~$200), with minor penalty in shift crispness. Mostly for bling.

name.zh_hant: 全碳纖維硬底鎖鞋 (Full Carbon Road Shoes)

verdict.zh_hant: 硬度指數 10+ 的碳纖底板徹底消除尼龍底的形變卸力，同時減輕足底末端旋轉質量，能顯著改善長途發力均勻度，緩解足底筋膜疲勞。
verdict.en: Carbon sole stiffness index 10+ stops energy dissipation from flexing, reducing foot hotspots and optimizing power delivery over long rides.

name.zh_hant: 空力破風鞋套 (Aero Shoe Covers)

verdict.zh_hant: 鎖鞋上的 BOA 旋鈕和魔術貼在高速旋轉時會產生大量紊流。百元鞋套平滑包裹鞋面，實測省瓦可觀，計時賽與平路高速必備。
verdict.en: Shoe dials and straps churn significant air turbulence when pedaling. A sleek shoe cover creates a laminar surface, yielding cheap aero watts.
